title: Topic 5: Feelings & States - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Say how you feel; ask others how they feel

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Talk about feelings today.
Say 4 things:
1. A greeting + how you are (Hello! I am fine... - T1)
2. TWO feeling words about you today (I am ... and ...)
3. One family member or friend: how is he/she today?
(My mother is... - T3)
4. Ask ME a question: Are you...?
Example: Hi! I am fine. I am happy but a little tired.
My father is hungry! And you? Are you tired?

Tip: Think: how are you REALLY today? Use true feelings!

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic05_feelings_states.txt, Lesson 5.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: He/She is + feeling for another person
